mapper.sql: place_id, external_provider, external_place_id, category, name, country_code, region, city, address, latitude, longitude, description, phone, website_url, average_rating, is_active AS active, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO places ( external_provider, external_place_id, category, name, country_code, region, city, address, latitude, longitude, description, phone, website_url, average_rating, is_active ) VALUES ( #{externalProvider}, #{externalPlaceId}, #{category}, #{name}, COALESCE(#{countryCode}, 'KR'), #{region}, #{city}, #{address}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{description}, #{phone}, #{websiteUrl}, #{averageRating}, COALESCE(#{active}, TRUE) )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM places WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY place_id DESC

SELECT FROM places
is_active = TRUE
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR region LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND category = #{category}
ORDER BY average_rating DESC, place_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE places SET category = #{category}, name = #{name}, region = #{region}, city = #{city}, address = #{address}, latitude = #{latitude}, longitude = #{longitude}, description = #{description}, phone = #{phone}, website_url = #{websiteUrl}, average_rating = #{averageRating}, is_active = #{active}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE place_id = #{placeId}
